summary: Retire the manual st2 portable release workflow and its caller references

replay.detail: Runtime claims and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, schema version or claim registration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and admission rule versions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Installed st and st2 binaries and the current st release/installer contracts are unchanged. The removed manual publishing entry is described under manual.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: Main loses the workflow_dispatch entry for publishing portable st2 source. Operators needing another st2 portable release must retain this workflow or choose a separately reviewed publishing route. The current st release workflow continues unchanged.

recovery.detail: Restoring the workflow from git reverses the publishing-entry retirement; stored runtime data needs no repair.
